# taskhub-scans (issue #49 pilot)

`public-fixture`. The pinned observed-scan document for the taskhub
pilot, regenerated byte-for-byte by
[`scripts/gen-taskhub-scan.mjs`](../../../../scripts/gen-taskhub-scan.mjs)
from the committed adapter's real scanner kernel run over
`../taskhub/`.

Provenance boundary: `stableKey`, `location`, `fingerprint`,
`candidates`, `mappingConfidence`, the adapter identity, and the
`revision` are kernel-derived; the closed `kind`, the structural
`evidence`, the snake_cased semantic `id`s, and the endpoint rows are
authored to the observed-scan grammar from the fixture sources (the
wire transport cannot carry this document — 128-byte detail tokens,
module-granular kernel edges). The committed fixture `.env` is outside
every scan read root and is never read.
